title: potentilla glandulifera var. virescens
intro: Potentilla glandulifera var. virescens, commonly known as Chinese burnet or green glandular potentilla, is a plant species of the Rosaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla glandulifera var. virescens include its ability to stimulate blood circulation, reduce pain and swelling, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
